This Agreement is made between Drumlin Logistics Ltd (the "Operator") and Fenmore Bicycles Ltd (the "Customer").

## 3. Storage
3.1 The Operator shall store the Goods in a secure, dry and temperature-controlled environment.
3.2 The Operator shall carry out a full stock count each calendar quarter and provide the results to the Customer within 5 Business Days of completing it.
3.3 The Operator shall not move the Goods to any other warehouse, save that it may do so in an emergency where the Goods are at risk of damage.

## 4. Charges
4.1 The Customer shall pay storage charges monthly in advance.
4.2 Notwithstanding clause 4.1, the Operator is entitled to increase the storage charges on 1 January each year by no more than the CPI rate.

## 5. Lien
5.1 The Operator shall have a general lien over the Goods for all unpaid charges.
